problem_keywords: silver tape peeling in cold weather
use_cases:
Sealing overlapping joins on reflective foil sarking, wall wraps, and duct
wraps

Taping joints on reflective bubble foil and foil-faced foam insulation
in steel sheds

General on-site repairs, patching, and temporary holding of
metalised membranes
not_for:
Vapour-permeable membranes requiring
breathable unsealed moisture paths
retrieval.rag_summary:
Proctor YouRippa Silver
represents a heavy-duty, silver-faced construction and duct tape within the
YouRippa range. Featuring an embossed, high-tensile waterproof backing coated
with an aggressive pressure-sensitive adhesive, it matches silver foil membranes
and ducting. It delivers an airtight, moisture-resistant seal for joining
reflective insulation, sealing foil laps, and performing durable jobsite repairs
without requiring scissors or knives.
